sentences.hanzi: 重阳节快到了，小明和丽丽决定为爷爷奶奶准备礼物。
sentences.pinyin: Chóngyángjié kuài dào le, Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì juédìng wèi yéye nǎinai zhǔnbèi lǐwù.
sentences.english: The Double Ninth Festival was coming up, and Xiaoming and Lili decided to prepare gifts for their grandparents.

sentences.hanzi: 小明说：“我想给爷爷买一盒菊花茶，他每天下午都喝茶。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: "Wǒ xiǎng gěi yéye mǎi yī hé júhuāchá, tā měitiān xiàwǔ dōu hē chá."
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, "I want to buy Grandpa a box of chrysanthemum tea. He drinks tea every afternoon."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“我想给奶奶买一块重阳糕，她喜欢吃甜的东西。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Wǒ xiǎng gěi nǎinai mǎi yī kuài chóngyánggāo, tā xǐhuan chī tián de dōngxi."
sentences.english: Lili said, "I want to buy Grandma a piece of Double Ninth cake. She likes to eat sweet things."

sentences.hanzi: 他们一起去商店，买了菊花茶和重阳糕。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yīqǐ qù shāngdiàn, mǎi le júhuāchá hé chóngyánggāo.
sentences.english: They went to the store together and bought chrysanthemum tea and a Double Ninth cake.

sentences.hanzi: 回家以后，他们把礼物放在桌子上。
sentences.pinyin: Huíjiā yǐhòu, tāmen bǎ lǐwù fàng zài zhuōzi shàng.
sentences.english: After they got home, they put the gifts on the table.

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶看见礼物，高兴地说：“谢谢你们，你们真懂事。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai kànjiàn lǐwù, gāoxìng de shuō: "Xièxie nǐmen, nǐmen zhēn dǒngshì."
sentences.english: Grandma saw the gifts and said happily, "Thank you. You're so thoughtful."

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷也笑着说：“这些礼物我们都很喜欢。”
sentences.pinyin: Yéye yě xiào zhe shuō: "Zhèxiē lǐwù wǒmen dōu hěn xǐhuan."
sentences.english: Grandpa also said with a smile, "We like these gifts very much."

sentences.hanzi: 下午，小明和丽丽为爷爷奶奶表演了一首古诗朗诵。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàwǔ, Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì wèi yéye nǎinai biǎoyǎn le yī shǒu gǔshī lǎngsòng.
sentences.english: In the afternoon, Xiaoming and Lili performed a classical poem recitation for their grandparents.

sentences.hanzi: 小明站在前面，丽丽站在旁边。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng zhàn zài qiánmiàn, Lìlì zhàn zài pángbiān.
sentences.english: Xiaoming stood in front, and Lili stood next to him.

sentences.hanzi: 他们一起大声地读：“独在异乡为异客，每逢佳节倍思亲。”
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yīqǐ dàshēng de dú: "Dú zài yìxiāng wéi yìkè, měi féng jiājié bèi sī qīn."
sentences.english: They read aloud together: "Alone in a foreign land, I am a stranger; at every festival I miss my family all the more."

sentences.hanzi: 虽然他们有一点紧张，但是读得很认真。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán tāmen yǒu yīdiǎn jǐnzhāng, dànshì dú de hěn rènzhēn.
sentences.english: Although they were a little nervous, they read very carefully.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷奶奶坐在沙发上，一边听一边笑。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye nǎinai zuò zài shāfā shàng, yībiān tīng yībiān xiào.
sentences.english: Grandpa and Grandma sat on the sofa, listening and smiling.

sentences.hanzi: 朗诵完了，奶奶说：“你们读得真好，我很感动。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎngsòng wán le, nǎinai shuō: "Nǐmen dú de zhēn hǎo, wǒ hěn gǎndòng."
sentences.english: After the recitation, Grandma said, "You read so well. I'm very moved."

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷说：“我也很喜欢，你们真是我们的好孩子。”
sentences.pinyin: Yéye shuō: "Wǒ yě hěn xǐhuan, nǐmen zhēn shì wǒmen de hǎo háizi."
sentences.english: Grandpa said, "I like it very much too. You really are our good children."

sentences.hanzi: 然后，一家人一起品尝重阳糕，还喝了菊花茶。
sentences.pinyin: Ránhòu, yījiā rén yīqǐ pǐncháng chóngyánggāo, hái hē le júhuāchá.
sentences.english: Then the whole family tasted the Double Ninth cake together and also drank chrysanthemum tea.

sentences.hanzi: 小明给爷爷倒了一杯茶。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng gěi yéye dào le yī bēi chá.
sentences.english: Xiaoming poured Grandpa a cup of tea.

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽给奶奶切了一块糕。
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì gěi nǎinai qiē le yī kuài gāo.
sentences.english: Lili cut a slice of cake for Grandma.

sentences.hanzi: 大家坐在一起，聊天、喝茶、吃糕，度过了一个温馨的下午。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā zuò zài yīqǐ, liáotiān, hē chá, chī gāo, dùguò le yī gè wēnxīn de xiàwǔ.
sentences.english: Everyone sat together, chatting, drinking tea, and eating cake, and spent a cozy afternoon.

sentences.hanzi: 小明说：“我希望每年重阳节都能这样过。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: "Wǒ xīwàng měinián Chóngyángjié dōu néng zhèyàng guò."
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, "I hope we can spend the Double Ninth Festival like this every year."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“我也是，和家人在一起最开心。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Wǒ yě shì, hé jiārén zài yīqǐ zuì kāixīn."
sentences.english: Lili said, "Me too. Being with family makes me happiest."
